meta.title: About — The Switzerland Chapter of ICF
meta.description: About The Switzerland Chapter of ICF: why coaching, our regional communities, and our research partnerships.

hero.lede: Welcome to the Swiss national chapter of the International Coaching Federation — a professional home for credentialed coaches and the organisations they serve.

why.title: Better conversations create better futures.
why.body: Professional coaching empowers people to think more clearly, lead more effectively and navigate change with confidence.

values.title: Think differently
values.desc: Coaching creates space to challenge assumptions and see new options.

values.title: Lead better
values.desc: Leaders who are coached listen deeper, decide faster and grow their people.

values.title: Unlock potential
values.desc: Individuals and teams reach for what matters most, with support and accountability.

items.title: The state of coaching in Switzerland 2026
items.desc: A joint study with Swiss universities on the growth and impact of professional coaching.

items.title: Coaching, AI and the future of work
items.desc: A partnership research programme exploring how AI is reshaping coaching practice.

mission.title: Advancing professional coaching in Switzerland.
mission.body: ICF Switzerland strengthens the quality, relevance and visibility of professional coaching. A welcoming, inclusive professional home for coaches across all regions and languages.

deib.title: Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging
deib.intro: DEIB is embedded in everything we do — not a side initiative, but a core value. Our chapter spans 4 languages, multiple nationalities, and a rich variety of coaching backgrounds. A dedicated DEIB team drives our strategy.
